SELECT A.CHANNEL_NAME AS SOURCE, IFNULL(B.count, 0) AS count, C.SYSCONF_VALUE AS timeouttotalcount FROM (SELECT CHANNEL_NAME FROM CHANNEL WHERE CHANNEL_ENABLE = 1) A LEFT JOIN (SELECT CBSPEND_CHANNEL, COUNT(1) AS count FROM CBSPEND WHERE CBSPEND_TX_DATE = TO_CHAR(CURRENT DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND LEFT(CBSPEND_TX_TIME, 4) = TO_CHAR(CURRENT TIMESTAMP, 'HH24MI') GROUP BY CBSPEND_CHANNEL) B ON A.CHANNEL_NAME = B.CBSPEND_CHANNEL LEFT JOIN SYSCONF C ON C.SYSCONF_NAME = 'TimeOutTotalCount' ORDER BY A.CHANNEL_NAME
